text:
incident-bot: PAGER: SEV2 — Elevated 5xx and latency from us-east-1 affecting Hosted API and several Dedicated pools. Pager sent to oncall-aisha. Auto-created incident channel and attached diagnostic links.

oncall-aisha: ACK. switching to incident channel. grabbing dashboards.

meera-runtime: I'm seeing a sharp jump in 5xx starting ~1769802400. Hosted API 5xx rate up to ~18% for us-east-1 region, median p95 latency increased from 120ms -> 1100ms. KV cache hit rates unchanged.

tom-sre: ALB/NGINX logs show backend responses 502/503 and connection resets to some upstreams. error pattern looks like AWS NLB/ENI errors rather than app-level rate limits.

jorge-dedicated: Confirmed dedicated pools in us-east-1 are seeing increased tail latency and occasional 504s. A few reservations were dropped and auto-restarted.

priya-support: Getting initial Customer Impact reports — 7 active customers reporting errors in the last 10 mins (mainly generation timeouts, some embed requests failing). CS has triaged and informed them we're investigating.

oncall-aisha: High-level triage: third-party (AWS regional) incident suspected. Can we confirm from cloud provider dashboard / status? meera-runtime, can you fetch cloudwatch ALB/NLB errors and any AWS Health events?

meera-runtime: Pulling. AWS Personal Health Dashboard shows an incident for us-east-1 EC2 ENI/Networking — status: Investigating. Link: https://status.aws.amazon.com/ (internal reference attached). CloudWatch: surge in ELB 5xx and target connection errors around 1769802400.

tom-sre: Also seeing increased timeouts on calls to AWS-managed auth (sts, iam) in same window — could explain spikes during token refresh for Dedicated hosts.

ops-bot: deploy-bot: Notified: suspend non-critical deploys to us-east-1.

oncall-aisha: Mitigation plan (short): 1) Shift non-critical traffic away from us-east-1 via smart routing / failover. 2) Reduce tail load: enable rate-limited queueing for non-SLAs. 3) For Dedicated pools: move burst workloads to healthy regions (jorge). 4) Notify customers on status page + CS. 5) Engage AWS support (tom).

jorge-dedicated: Starting pool rebalancing: will drain connections for two lower-priority dedicated pools and rebuild in us-west-2. Command I'm running: `reroute-dedicated --from us-east-1 --to us-west-2 --pools p-123,p-456 --grace 60s` (dry-run succeeded).

meera-runtime: For Hosted API: flipping traffic route for new requests with routing policy override: `PATCH /routing/v1/regions` payload: `{ "preferred": ["us-west-2","eu-west-1"], "avoid": ["us-east-1"] }` — applying now. Streaming connections may still hit existing terminals in us-east-1 for a short window.

oncall-aisha: Good. Prioritize minimizing customer-visible 5xx even if latency to other regions is slightly higher.

priya-support: Posting interim message to status.redwood.ai: "We are investigating elevated errors and latency in our us-east-1 region. Traffic routing changes are in progress to mitigate impact; some requests may experience higher latency but fewer failures."

tom-sre: Opened AWS case #CASE-2026-XXXX: PROVIDER-REPORTED: ENI/Network degradation in us-east-1. Shared logs and request IDs. AWS acknowledged and assigned a specialist. See ticket link.

meera-runtime: Observability note: we saw a correlated spike in STS timeouts causing token refresh failures (~2% of requests) which cascaded into retries and contributed to higher tail latencies. Adding a short-term icing: increase local token cache TTL to 600s to reduce STS calls. Command: `config set auth.token_ttl 600 --scope runtime`

jorge-dedicated: Rebalance started for p-123, p-456. Expected drain 90s -> will monitor.

oncall-aisha: Handoff note: I'm scheduled to hand off to oncall-priya in ~40 minutes. Priya, can you take lead on customer comms and postmortem timeline?

priya-support: I can take the lead. Will coordinate CS messages and assemble affected customer list. Also will prepare an initial RCA stub.

ops-bot: autoscaler: Automated scaling paused for us-east-1 to avoid oscillations.

tom-sre: After routing change, hosted 5xx rate down from 18% -> 4% in ~6 minutes. p95 latency for traffic now routed to us-west-2 ~250ms. Dedicated pool errors falling but still some residual 5xx from in-flight requests.

meera-runtime: Added temporary fallback policy: if model backend returns 5xx, fallback to smaller model variant without quantization to preserve availability. Code toggle: `feature-flags set fallback_model_on_5xx true`

priya-support: Customer impact estimate: ~12 customers affected intermittently over the last 30m; 3 had persistent errors needing manual mitigation. We'll send targeted follow-ups to those 3.

oncall-aisha: Good live mitigation. Action items: - tom: keep AWS case active, push for root cause and ETA - meera: validate token TTL change and rollback plan - jorge: finish dedicated pool moves and verify latency/throughput - priya: status page + customer comms + incident lead after handoff - ops-bot: keep autoscaler paused until cleared

tom-sre: AWS support update: Engineers are seeing high packet loss between AZs in us-east-1. They've implemented local reroutes; monitoring. No ETA yet.

meera-runtime: Observability: post-traffic-shift metrics look stable. Error budget burn reduced. Rolling back token_ttl change in 2 hours if stable.

priya-support: Status page update posted and linked to CS threads. Preparing a short customer-facing timeline for the next update in 30 mins.

oncall-aisha: Handing off: priya-support is incident lead. I will remain reachable for escalations. Priya, please include me in the follow-up.

priya-support: Taking over as lead. Will collate logs for postmortem and start incident document. Estimated incident severity: SEV2 -> will consider downgrade to SEV3 if no regression in next hour.

ops-bot: monitor-bot: Alert suppression applied to reduce noise for known transient errors.

tom-sre: Next steps: keep AWS case open, collect packet captures and ELB logs, and request timeline for full recovery.

priya-support: Last public update posted. Next internal sync at +30m. If anyone sees a regression, ping @priya-support directly.

meera-runtime: Leaving runbook notes: possible root cause chain — AWS ENI/network degradation -> STS token timeouts -> retry amplification -> backend overload -> 5xx spike. We'll validate in RCA.

priya-support: Logged handover in incident doc. last_message_ts=1769804299.

incident-bot: Incident channel marked "active"; runbook entries created and assigned.
